messages:
Elaine: OK team — final prep for tonight's Night Market pop-up. Quick checklist: booth flow, demo rotations, swag, lead routing, speaker swap. Who's ownership for each?
Mike: I'll own booth flow + AV check. Arrive 4:30p for load-in.
Sam: I can handle demo rotations and lead routing. Will bring the iPad & QR list.
Jia: Swag status — stickers printed, postcards delayed (printer pinged). We have 120 tees, 200 stickers, 400 postcards requested but might only get 250.
Olivia-bot: Shipping note: Skyship pickup scheduled 17:00 today. Tracking SHP-8842.
Harry: Can I get a compact checklist for the hourly demo schedule? Want to hand to folks on shift.
Sam: Sure — 15-min demos, 5-min buffer, two people per demo table. I'll post CSV in #marketing-assets.
Jia: Also redesign suggestion: new 'benchmarks one-pager' QR code on the postcard — links to the micro-benchmarks blog post + signup form. Good idea?
Elaine: Love it. Sam — can you make a short CTA for the landing page? Something like: "See live latency & cost for common prompts — scan to compare"
Sam: Draft CTA: "Compare live latency & token-cost for common prompts — scan to demo." Will drop in #marketing-assets now.
Mike: AV update: projector adapter inventory check — we have 2x HDMI-C, 1x USB-C. If the speaker needs dongle, bring own. Also will test mic at 5:15p.
SkyshipVendor: ETA driver 17:05. Please confirm booth contact name and phone for handoff.
Elaine: Contact: Mike +1-415-555-0123. Driver to check ID, sign manifest.
Jia: Swag packing list (short): 120 tees, 250 postcards, 200 stickers, 2 banners, 1 demo cradle, 4 power bricks.
Harry: I'll print 10 paper copies of the hourly schedule and one big laminated flow for the booth.
Sam: Lead routing: QR submits go straight to HubSpot form with utm=nightmarket; assign to Outreach queue (priority: demo leads -> pd-later tag). We'll triage next morning.
Elaine: Good. Two more items: 1) Speaker swap — our 7:30pm slot, speaker from partner dropped. We need a quick replacement or shorten to panel. Any volunteers? 2) Post-event content plan — who captures quick clips?
Mike: I can ask Ben (devrel) if he can step in for 15 min. If not, swap to a 20-min fireside with Qs.
Sam: I can man the camera for clips for 10 mins at 8:00p. Liaise with DevRel for sound.
Jia: If postcards are lower than expected, prioritize postcards with QR + bench one-pager. Stickers as freebie at demo table.
Olivia-bot: Reminder: Permit on file expires 21:00. Event ops confirmed extension allowed until 22:00 upon request.
Elaine: Perfect. Final ask: everyone add any urgent notes in the next 45m. We'll do a 4:20p quick sync by the loading dock.
Mike: Noted. Sync at 16:20.
SkyshipVendor: Driver confirmed handoff instructions. Manifest will be left with Mike.
Sam: P.S. hack: for faster lead import, export nightly CSV headers as: email, name, company, utm_source, demo_topic, note. I'll paste quick sample:
```
email,name,company,utm_source,demo_topic,note
alice@example.com,Alice,Acme,nightmarket,embeddings-demo,interested in pricing follow-up
```
Jia: Thx — printing a small sticker to mark "benchmarks" postcards so outreach can filter manually if needed.
Harry: Last logistic: power strip shortage — anyone have an extra 6-outlet? If not, we improvise.
Mike: I have one. Bringing it.
Elaine: Awesome. Thanks everyone. See you at 16:20 by the loading dock. :rocket:
